questions.question: Who was appointed as the Prime Minister (PM) of Lebanon? (Jan 2020)
questions.explanation: Hassan Diab was appointed Prime Minister of Lebanon in January 2020, succeeding Saad Hariri.

source.ref: SBI PO Mains 2021 (memory-based, Testbook Mains book)

questions.question: Which country ranks lower than India in the Global Hunger Index 2020?
questions.explanation: India ranked 94th in GHI 2020. Of the listed countries, only Nigeria (98th) ranked below India; Bangladesh (75), Myanmar (78), Pakistan (88) and Nepal (73) ranked above.

source.ref: SBI PO Mains 2021 (memory-based, Testbook Mains book)

questions.question: In GRIHA, H stands for?
questions.explanation: GRIHA stands for Green Rating for Integrated Habitat Assessment, India's national green-building rating system.

questions.question: Which one of the following is the largest producer of crude oil?
questions.explanation: The United States has been the world's largest crude oil producer since 2018, ahead of Russia and Saudi Arabia.

questions.question: The Indian Parliament House was designed by?
questions.explanation: The (old) Parliament House in New Delhi was designed by Edwin Lutyens and Herbert Baker and completed in 1927.

questions.question: Which company relaunched the Jawa and Yezdi bikes in India?
questions.explanation: Classic Legends, a subsidiary backed by Mahindra & Mahindra, revived the Jawa (2018) and Yezdi motorcycle brands in India.

questions.question: Ethanol blending subsidy is ___ per annum or 50% of the rate of interest charged by banks, whichever is lower.
questions.explanation: Under the government's interest subvention scheme for ethanol capacity augmentation, the subsidy is 6% per annum or 50% of the interest charged by banks, whichever is lower.

questions.question: Choose the incorrect answer regarding Pradhan Mantri Vaya Vandana Yojana (PMVVY)?
options: Last fiscal year to apply is 2023-24
The scheme provides for an assured return of 8% percent per annum payable monthly
Minimum Age: 60 years; no maximum age limit
It is operated and managed by LIC
The period for this scheme is 12 years
questions.explanation: PMVVY is a pension scheme for senior citizens (60+) run by LIC with a policy term of 10 years, not 12 - so the 12-year statement is incorrect.

source.ref: SBI PO Mains 2021 (memory-based, Testbook Mains book)

questions.question: The Living Root Bridges are a rare ecological phenomenon seen in which state of India?
questions.explanation: Living root bridges, grown from the aerial roots of rubber fig trees, are found in Meghalaya (notably around Cherrapunji and Mawlynnong).

source.ref: SBI PO Mains 2021 (memory-based, Testbook Mains book)

questions.question: According to BASEL-II guidelines the minimum CRAR is 9%. RBI released the 22nd issue of the Financial Stability Report (FSR). The capital to risk-weighted assets ratio (CRAR) of Scheduled Commercial Banks improved to how much per cent in September 2020, from 14.7 per cent in March 2020?
questions.explanation: Per the RBI's 22nd Financial Stability Report (January 2021), the CRAR of scheduled commercial banks improved to 15.8% in September 2020 from 14.7% in March 2020.

source.ref: SBI PO Mains 2021 (memory-based, Testbook Mains book)
